We are a Hobie dealership so of course we have the Hobie Waves and Hobie Getaways available to rent! The Hobie Wave (14FT) is the smaller sailboat that has only the mainsail and fits 2-3 people. The Hobie Getaway (16FT) is the bigger sailboat that has the mainsail and the jib, along with wings and a tramp. This boat can hold up to 3-6 depending on everyone's size. We ONLY rent to people who have sailing experience, we do not offer any lessons when it comes to sailing. services.desc: Prices 1/2 Hour Rental: $80 1 Hour Rental: $150 ----------------- About We have an all new fleet of Sea-Doo’s for you to enjoy! Our jet ski rentals take place on Pensacola Beach and can seat up to three people. For comfort and weight, we only allow two adults on the jet ski and a child if you wish to fill all three seats. Normally, three adults on the jet ski just isn’t the most comfortable and for safety reasons we put this in place. If you wish to change drivers or passengers, there is no extra charge.
